steps.text: 2:55 P.M. \ Overcast
Londinium

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Lady Golding, at last, you're back!

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Did I make it in time?

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Of course. You've rehearsed this play for well over a year, and this is the first time the children are performing the whole thing. We couldn't possibly start the show without you.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I must find myself a good seat, then.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Children, are you ready?

steps.name: Mischievous Boys & Innocent Girls
steps.text: Ready!

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Let's begin, then.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Lights—

steps.name: Farmer
steps.text: Good morning, sir! There is a look of concern on your face. Is something worrying you?

steps.name: Noble
steps.text: The horn of victory has blown atop the walls for three days and nights, but why do I feel uneasy?

steps.name: Farmer
steps.text: Has our great general not returned triumphant? Praise his bravery and fearlessness!

steps.name: Noble
steps.text: Bravery? Fearlessness? Perhaps. But you did not see the light in his eyes when he returned? When he gazed upon the crown, he was like a condorwing circling above a limping meatbeast.

steps.name: Farmer
steps.text: Greed can send the most kindhearted man straight to hell.

steps.name: Noble
steps.text: And the masses will forever believe he reaped only what he had sown.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: These are our terms, Miss Allerdale.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: You need certain... 'goods' transported into Londinium, and this is nothing like what we usually carry. Both the quantity and the weight... are highly unusual.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: I shan't ask what it is you need transported and why you need them brought into the city, but you must know that the risk we will carry for transporting them is immense.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: And I'm certain you know there are not many men out there who can do this for you.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: The Sarkaz keep a close eye on all ports of entry. Should they learn of this under-the-table deal, not one of us will leave Londinium alive.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Even if your background and the greed of your friends watching your back are enough to keep your lifestyle in Central Londinium as is, I'm afraid they won't help with this affair.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: If you want this deal to go through, you must put something worth the risk on the table.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Thank you for agreeing to meet with me, Mr. Bader. I will consider your proposal.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Time waits for no one. You must make your decision soon.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Their asking price is high.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We've discussed this situation. The Royal Mint is in Sarkaz hands. News of this must've already spread throughout the entire country via the Magna bankers.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Merchant smugglers are worried that the payment they earn will be worthless by this time next month. Naturally, they demand a method of payment that will keep its value in the long term.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You intend to accept his terms?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Mr. Bader was right. 'Time waits for no one.'

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We have at most five more days to prepare. If we are to ambush the Defense Forces' command tower, we need to bring more weapons into the city.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But... what they demand is very dear to you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But this is the position we are in, Clovisia.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: This is the position I am in.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: How would you figure what it means to me?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I'm afraid...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: No, I can say this for sure. Your speculations are all wrong.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Do you think of me simply as the magnificent Duke of Cumberland?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You likely weren't even born yet, but I...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I saw them hang Victoria's magnificent Lion King in the palace gardens with my own two eyes.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: My name is Cumberland, and everyone knows Cumberland was His Majesty's most faithful friend.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Do you think the reason I stand here in front of you completely unharmed is because the bigwigs in Parliament had mercy on me?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Even now, I still regularly attend Lt. Colonel Lettou's cocktail parties. My words still carry some weight there, and they still need me to soothe the masses.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Of course, this is for our cause. It is also my own means.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I understand your sacrifice. Without your protection, the Self-Salvation Corps could not have made it to this day.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm not a girl anymore...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: That thing in the attic means nothing.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It is a pile of scrap.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...Ailshie.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Make the arrangements and have it brought down from the attic.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You disagree with my decision?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: I dare not speak, Miss.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I demand it of you.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Lady Allerdale, no matter what you say, it... it's still House Cumberland's steam armor!

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: The blood of your ancestors—that most esteemed Duke's blood flows within that armor. It is an honor that Victoria bestowed upon House Cumberland, and it is the symbol of your house, 'Ever on High.'

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: It can be destroyed in the flames of war, it can be given to another who is noble and unsullied. It can't... It can't be traded to a greedy merchant.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You don't think Mr. Bader is worthy?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: An ancient set of armor! Treated as a lowly collectible! And then traded away at a bargain price for just—

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie, you've been at my side all these years, ever since I was born.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We've kept the long fallen 'House Cumberland' alive.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: My house was built on nothing but a bunch of empty words. 'Glory,' 'loyalty,' 'nobility,' or perhaps, 'benevolence?' But none of them hold any meaning today.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's you and I upon whom this house now stands.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: I understand, Miss.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Have we gotten a letter from them today...?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You know? The music of the past... as if it still rings loud in my head.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: This manor once hosted a king, but where is he now?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: My apologies, Your Highness—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Call me Vina.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Welcome, Vina.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I've returned from patrolling with the fighters.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You're still willing to go on missions with the fighters of the Self-Salvation Corps. Splendid.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I want to do as much as I can.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's more than enough for the men to simply know you are here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I've heard from Clovisia...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hah, the attic is absolutely cluttered with rubbish. I've got to pull myself together and clean up a bit.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Lots of dust there. I mustn't have Your Highness helping me with such things.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I don't want you to sell the armor.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Is that an edict from Your Highness?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I have no right to issue one. You're the one responsible for the Self-Salvation Corps, not me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You know better than I what's right for the Corps, and I understand that the armor can buy us an opportunity.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But... Please give me some time.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I will find a way.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina... You needn't worry yourself over this.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Is that an order from the Self-Salvation Corps' Auchterigg District leader?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: If nothing ever happened, perhaps...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Never mind, it's all in the past.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Lady Heidi!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: What is it? Do we have any news from Golding?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Yes, she just sent us a message through the transmitter at the bookstore. It's been forwarded to your terminal.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Good... Very good.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: She says she's safe. Everything in Auchterigg is proceeding according to plan.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Please send a reply. The Doctor's squad has successfully slipped past the checkpoint and infiltrated Highbury. Thanks to the mercenaries working with Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Catherine, there's a problem with the conveyor belt at Loading Area No. 9!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Let's have a look.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: There's a loose nut.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Patto!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're on shift today, and we're running shorter and shorter on time. What are you doing?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: If we don't speed things up, the Sarkaz will smear your brains across this steel here!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Sorry, Catherine.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Now hand me the spanner.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Okay...
Here.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Quick on your feet, all of a sudden...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Long time no see, Granny.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Patto!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Catherine...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: See your team leader after work for a write-up.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You let unauthorized personnel into the factory's most important landing zone. You're lucky you haven't been sacked.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny, this isn't Patto's fault. It wasn't him who let me in.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Good. Patto, bring Tommy and Day with you to get written up. I'd better not see a single one of you trying to wiggle out of this.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You, and the strange character from god-knows-where next to you...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: Sir, why is the palace so quiet?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Palace? What palace?

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: You are facing the outer walls of the palace.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Move aside, big heap of metal. You're blocking the sunlight.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: I'm facing nothing but an empty house.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: I am a Steam Knight. I purge all evil and injustice!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Young man, it's over.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: No, it is not, nor shall it ever be!

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: So long as we still know what is right and what is wrong, so long as we never hesitate to make the right decision, it shall never be over!

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: I made my way here precisely for that reason. I invite all men to join me!

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: Even you have yet to relax your tightly clenched fist, am I right?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya, our cover's blown!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How many hostiles?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Recon operators report four mercenary patrol teams headed in our direction.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to pass through the district to reach the Defense Forces' command tower.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: And we've only just made it inside...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sarkaz forces are way too quick to react. We're being ambushed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How is the backup route looking?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: If the mercenaries have been lured to the front here...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No, it won't work!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There's another squad coming up fast! The Self-Salvation Corps just spotted them!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What did they say?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They had a run-in with this squad when they evacuated from Sudean! They say these Sarkaz fight... well they're...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Inhuman.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Vampire's men...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Notify all units. The operation has been cancelled. Prepare to pull out immediately.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There's no time. The Vampire fighters are moving way too fast... The Self-Salvation Corps has engaged them!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Change of plans. We're aiding the Self-Salvation Corps!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Where's the Cautus?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: What Cautus?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't play dumb with me. She's been with you lot the last couple days.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: I've no idea what you're talking about, and I'm not talking. Not even if you kill me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Another stubborn bunch.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Urghh—! What's this... Bugs?! Bloody...!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hang in there, friend!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Back in formation. Don't let the bugs on the ground separate you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Defender operators, cover our allies' retreat!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island and the Self-Salvation Corps came here together, and so we will leave together!
